breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly removed the flawed instruction to 'replace the distributed self-weight by a single concentrated load'. Instead, it specified the correct method based on the hint, using the integral of the continuously varying axial force P(x), which aligns with the ground truth.
